source: CBOE delayed quotes (cdn.cboe.com), one request per name

filters.rows_x: flip fallback only: strikes 35-60% away and expiries past max_dte, used when rows give no flip

method_note: Compute with the MME method: business-day T/262, sticky-strike BS gamma, dealers long calls / short puts, 120-pt 0.8-1.2x flip sweep; walls from gamma_vendor aggregated by strike at spot, closest strike at or above 25% of the side maximum.
